paragraphs: Yalkut, Tehillim, remez 703: so it is cited in Otzar Yisrael. Hyman adds: “But I have not found it there.”[^1]

notes.text: The complete actual Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 703 paragraph beginning ארחץ בנקיון כפי explicitly has Rabbi Zeira bar Abba reporting Rabbi Yochanan. That locally supports the full title in the heading. Hyman’s citation of Otzar Yisrael and first-person “I have not found it there” remain his historical bibliographic statements; the digital match does not establish what he saw or repair his Hebrew. No additional teaching is imported.
